doc.title: Jerry Bergonzi interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 7, 2022

title: Being 'woke' and politics
summary: The word awake leads to 'woke' and he calls himself a radical liberal who supports easier voting.

story.theme_name: Race and segregation in the jazz life
story.community_name: Politics, race and the state of the country

blocks.x: Oh man. Then when you said that — awake — I think of well there’s a current term now called “woke.”
Are you woke? What does woke mean? Are you a liberal?
I believe it is definitely connected with that.

I like music. I think the election wasn’t stolen. I think that it was a big insurrection and yeah, I’m not — and I think people should have the right to vote, it shouldn’t be like make it harder for people to vote, they should make it easier for people to vote. Is that being woke? I don’t know. If it is I guess I’m woke.
